name: ui-ime-conversion
title: IME Kana-Kanji Conversion
description: Ô nhập gõ từng chữ kana dưới gạch chấm, bấm Space thì từng cụm loé nền màu và bảng gợi ý bật ra, bấm Enter thì chốt chữ và gạch chân biến mất.

moworks.author: moworks

options.states: what the field shows after each key (Telex here; kana for Japanese)
options.window: the candidate window (its children are the rows)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after BudouX (Apache-2.0) for phrase-aware line breaks

moworks.notes: Field 280 px, text 26 px. From 0.35 s one kana per 90 ms (≤ 1.6 s) under a dotted 1 px underline. 0.3 s after the last, Space: text turns into the conversion; each segment flashes an accent block (text in background colour) 0.3 s, 80 ms apart; underlines solid 1 px, focused segment 2.5 px accent; a 3-candidate window (first row accent) fades in 0.1–0.25 s later. 1 s later Enter commits: underlines and window gone. Caret 2 px accent, 0.5 s blink. Exit 4.45–4.75 s. Params: nhịp gõ (90 ms / kana) · loé đổi chữ (0.3 s, lệch 80 ms) · chốt sau (1 s). Space turns the composition into segments that flash 0.3 s, 0.08 s apart, and opens three candidates; Enter, a second later, commits and clears the underlines.
